name: TeraWulf Inc.
blurb: TeraWulf is a power-infrastructure company that began as a renewable-energy-powered bitcoin miner and has pivoted toward high-performance computing (HPC) and AI data-centre hosting. It operates the Lake Mariner facility in New York and the Nautilus Cryptomine joint venture in Pennsylvania, with a focus on nuclear- and hydro-powered compute capacity — a differentiator in an era of AI-driven power scarcity.
recent: By early 2026, more than 50% of TeraWulf's revenue derived from HPC hosting, up from approximately zero two years prior, anchored by multi-year contracts with Core42 and Fluidstack. In April 2026, the company raised over $900 million in a common-stock offering to fund Lake Mariner HPC build-out phase 3 and retire convertible debt. The stock moved from a 52-week low near $3.18 to a high of roughly $19.31, a gain of approximately 507% over the trailing twelve months, though at a price-to-book ratio far above industry norms.
